intro: A Trogg Stone Tooth is a rugged, mineralized tooth taken from the Stonesplinter troggs infesting the hills of Loch Modan. Dwarven defenders use these teeth as physical proof that wandering adventurers are thinning the trogg numbers around the southern frontier.

p: With the Ironforge Reserve committed to the Alliance Front, local dwarven garrisons are stretched thin across Khaz Modan. At the southern gate guard tower in Loch Modan, Captain Rugelfuss cannot spare his soldiers from their posts to mount offensive patrols against the lurking Stonesplinter troggs. Instead, he issues a standing call for volunteers to hunt the creatures in the nearby hills. To confirm that the menace is being driven back, Rugelfuss demands Trogg Stone Teeth as crude, undeniable evidence of every beast slain.
